articles.title: My day
articles.description: A very short text about a normal day.
articles.content:
My name is Anna. I get up at seven o'clock. I eat bread and drink tea.

I go to work by bus. I work in a shop. I like my work.

In the evening I go home. I eat dinner with my brother. Then I read a book and go to bed.

articles.title: A weekend in the city
articles.description: Tom spends two days in a big city.
articles.content:
Tom lives in a small town, but last weekend he visited his friend Maria in London. She has a flat near a big park.

On Saturday they walked in the park and had lunch in a small cafe. In the afternoon they visited a museum. Tom liked the old paintings very much.

On Sunday it rained, so they stayed at home. They cooked pasta and watched a film. In the evening Tom took the train home. He was tired, but he was happy.
